comment: Independent C-first lawful Valkyrie. A debug-created rock mole (M1_TUNNEL, no pick needed) follows the hero west through three debug-wished trees in a row. dig.c mdig_tunnel() turns each tree to ROOM; the first takes pile=1 and calls mkobj.c rnd_treefruit_at(), which draws rn2(5) from treefruits[], and the other two take pile>4 and make nothing. Independent seed, clock, role and route.
